localsend-bin on Omarchy

The prebuilt-binary package of LocalSend, ready to send files across your network without a build step.

Package data synced 2026-10-28 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install localsend-bin on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add localsend-bin. It is a 21 MB download (56.3 MB installed), version 1.18.2-1, licensed Apache-2.0. An open source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install localsend-bin on Omarchy

Same app as the localsend source package: a free, open-source, cross-platform tool for beaming files and messages between nearby devices over a local network, with no cloud account or internet connection required. This variant is packaged as a precompiled binary for a faster install.

Watch: LocalSend - Airdrop for us All! ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add localsend-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.18.2-1:
    pacman -Qi localsend-bin

Open and use localsend-bin

localsend-bin is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql localsend-bin | grep applications

localsend-bin requirements and compatibility

  • Sending device must be reachable over a local network (Wi-Fi/LAN) with the receiving device

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • fuse2
  • xdg-user-dirs
  • libayatana-appindicator
  • libayatana-indicator

Free and open source. License: Apache-2.0.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install localsend-bin on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add localsend-bin. The download is 21 MB and it takes 56.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is localsend-bin free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed Apache-2.0.

How do I uninstall localsend-bin?

Run omarchy pkg drop localsend-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does localsend-bin depend on?

The package declares 4 dependencies: fuse2, xdg-user-dirs, libayatana-appindicator, libayatana-indicator. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is localsend-bin a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for localsend-bin.

Is localsend-bin in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as localsend-bin (version 1.18.2-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. LocalSend makes it. Project site: https://github.com/localsend/localsend.
